result.reason: The added language covers the required vendor-side triggers and expressly includes defense of third-party claims, but it does not add the required notice, control-of-defense, and cooperation procedures. It also fails to limit Client’s indemnity to Client-provided content and Client’s breach of law; indeed, the Client indemnity remains incomplete after the introductory colon. The reordering and duplicative vendor-indemnity structure are unnecessary and leave the clause awkwardly drafted, although unrelated commercial intent is generally preserved.
